brief:
The United Nations General Assembly's Fourth Committee adopted three draft resolutions Wednesday addressing Palestinian aid, property rights, and Israeli occupation, according to Middle East Eye. The resolutions support the mandate and operations of UN bodies working on Palestinian affairs.

The committee's action follows ongoing international debate over Palestinian governance, humanitarian assistance, and the status of territories under Israeli control. The draft resolutions now advance toward consideration by the full General Assembly.

title: UN committee backs three resolutions on Palestinian rights and Israeli occupation
